**Premise correction to item 5 (CSP note)** — the measurement from objectui#6599's rewrite (PR objectui#6601) falsified what this card's item 5 assumed.

This card said: *"the console CSP's `connect-src` allows `https://*.sentry.io`"*. Measured reality: **the Console ships no CSP at all** — `apps/console/index.html` sets no CSP meta tag, the repo defines no default policy, and the only mention of CSP anywhere in objectui was the fabricated section of the old `error-tracking.md` (now rewritten to say so honestly).

Item 5 therefore reduces to: a runtime-delivered DSN has **no in-repo CSP obstacle**; the only CSP story is the one the rewritten doc already carries — an operator whose *hosting layer* serves CSP headers must allow their own DSN's ingest origin in `connect-src`. The dev implementing this card should keep that doc section accurate for the server-delivered shape and add nothing CSP-related to the code.

**Both halves are merged — closing as completed.**

- Server half: [PR #12697](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12697) (merged 2026-08-27 11:06Z) — `/api/v1/runtime/config` serves `telemetry.errorReporting` as one closed object; DSN presence is the grant; the #10805 boolean removed in the same change with its pending changeset superseded; malformed refused loudly at mount; secret-bearing DSNs refused; `OS_CLOUD_URL=off` still refuses to serve a sink.
- Client half: [objectui#6603](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/6603) (merged 2026-08-27 10:56Z) — the gate collapses to one runtime-served input; every `VITE_SENTRY_*` retired except `VITE_SENTRY_RELEASE`; the committed-telemetry ratchet extended with counter-probes for the runtime-side spelling.

The acceptance holds end to end: a self-hosting operator enables client error reporting with **one server-side environment variable** (`OS_TELEMETRY_CLIENT_ERROR_REPORTING_DSN`), no frontend rebuild; unset ⇒ off; malformed ⇒ loud refusal; no dual-spelling window in either landing order (both directions were pinned by test and the order ended up irrelevant — both merged within ten minutes).

Ratified sub-decisions recorded in both PM reviews: the env family keeps the vendor-neutral `CLIENT_ERROR_REPORTING` convention, and `replaysOnErrorSampleRate` joins the closed set (privacy-bearing knobs may not stay stranded on the build side). Both are one-line changes if the maintainer ever prefers otherwise.
